API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APICertificate ManagementAdds a certificate with a private key for the specified customer.
Adds a certificate with a private key for the specified customer.
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/certificate

Adds a certificate with a private key for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
certBlob
string
REQUIRED
description
string
name
string
REQUIRED
